subject: O Level Physics
title: Trampoline velocity time graph
question:
Fig. 1.1 shows the velocity-time graph of a child playing with a trampoline. The child jumps off from a high platform and lands on the trampoline at X. Between X and Y, the child is in contact with the trampoline. Z is the highest position reached by the child as she rises. Air resistance is negligible.
(a) Describe the motion of the child between Y and Z.
(b) Explain, in terms of forces, why the graph between Y and Z is a straight line.
(c) Calculate the maximum height from position Y reached by the child after rebounding.
referenceNote: The original figure from the physics paper.

scene: The graph lines are given as data points and the renderer scales them onto the grid.
tikz: First try: the label Y was cut off because it sat below the edge of the graph.
Second try: allowed labels to go past the edge.
svg: About fifty grid lines and every tick position were written out by hand.

figure:
A velocity time graph on a grid. Time in seconds on the horizontal axis from 0 to 2.8 s, marked every 0.5 s. Velocity in m/s on the vertical axis from −7 to 11, marked every 5.
A straight line from (0, 0) up to X at (1.0, 10). A dashed line from X down to Y at (1.2, −6). A straight line from Y up to Z at (1.8, 0).
Label X, Y and Z. Axis labels: time / s and velocity / m/s. Caption: Fig. 1.1.
